# Step - loops

`loops` · category: [Branches and loops](../../traversal/step_reference.md#branches-and-loops)

Within repeat(): yields the current iteration count (of the named loop).

## Forms

```text
loops()
loops(arg1: string)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).repeat(__.out()).until(__.loops().is(2)).values("name").to_list()   // ["ripple", "lop"]
```
